Add `minds-admin analytics analyst add|remove|list`: operator management of per-analyst read-only access to the activated tier's analytics lakes. `add` creates the `analyst_<name>` role on the metrics and transcripts DuckLake catalogs (transcripts included by default; `--no-transcripts` opts out and removes any existing transcripts access), mints one read-only bucket-scoped R2 token per lake, and emits a self-documenting credentials TOML whose header carries a copy-pasteable DuckDB quick start with the real values substituted. Re-running `add` rotates the credentials; `remove` drops the role and revokes the tokens; `list` reconstructs everyone's access state from the roles, grants, and tokens (all deterministically named, so no extra state is kept).
